## 6247 N Rockwell St — Zoning & Development Analysis
**PIN:** 13012120030000 | **Parcel resolution:** authoritative

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **RS-2 (Residential Single-Unit)** per the City's official GIS parcel records, last updated 2025-12-01. No rezoning ordinance is on record — this is the long-standing base district. The district is described at [5].

**Verify:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning)

---

### 2. Can You Build a Two-Flat?

**No — not by right.** RS-2 is a single-family detached-house district [5]. The minimum lot area per dwelling unit is 5,000 sq ft [1], and this lot is only 4,125 sq ft, which means it cannot meet the per-unit standard even for one additional unit (4,125 ÷ 5,000 = 0.8 → **0 additional units**). The RS-3 "Predominance of the Block" exemption that can allow a two-unit building at 1,500 sq ft per unit [1] applies only in **RS-3**, not RS-2. A two-flat is not a permitted use in RS-2 in any case.

**Verify:** [1] (§17-2-0303); zone table at §17-2-0102 [5].

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards (RS-2)

| Standard | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Floor Area Ratio (FAR) | **0.65** | Zone table, §17-2-0102 [5] |
| Maximum height | **30 ft** | Zone table, §17-2-0102 [5] |
| Min. lot area per dwelling unit | **5,000 sq ft** | [1] (§17-2-0303-A) |
| Min. lot size | **5,000 sq ft** | Zone table, §17-2-0102 [5] |
| Off-street parking location | Must be on the same zoning lot; prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 ft of the front property line | [2] (§17-10-0601-A/B) |

> *The lot-area-per-unit figure governs density only; FAR, height, parking, and lot configuration can further constrain what's buildable — and this 4,125 sq ft lot already falls below the 5,000 sq ft minimum.*

Setback dimensions for RS-2 are in §17-2-0400 of the Zoning Ordinance — that section was not retrieved here; contact the Department of Planning & Development or review the code directly to confirm front, rear, and side setback requirements.

---

### 4. Overlays & Special Designations

- **Planned Development:** No [data from regulatory record].
- **Landmark / Historic District:** No — not a landmark building, not in a landmark or historic district, not on the National Register.
- **Lakefront Protection / Pedestrian Street / PMD / Special District:** None apply.
- **ADU-Allowed RS Area:** **No.** Coach houses and conversion units are permitted in RS districts only within a designated ADU-Allowed RS Area under [3] (§17-7-0570); this parcel is not in one.
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone:** **Yes.** This parcel is in an ARO Zone. Community area West Ridge has 6 ARO-related projects totaling 324 units, including senior developments such as G & A Senior Residences at Ravenswood (89 units) and West Ridge Senior Apts. (117 units). ARO obligations are typically triggered by larger residential or commercial developments seeking city financial assistance or zoning changes — confirm applicability with the Dept. of Housing.
- **Special Service Area:** No.
- **Transit-Oriented/Transit-Served:** **Not TOD-eligible.** The nearest CTA rail is Morse (Red Line, ~1.71 mi); nearest Metra is Peterson/Ridge (Union Pacific North, ~1.04 mi). Neither is close enough to trigger Connected Communities Ordinance TOD benefits.
- **FEMA Flood Zone:** **Zone X — Area of Minimal Flood Hazard.** Not a Special Flood Hazard Area; flood insurance is not federally required.
- **Brownfields:** None identified nearby.

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Reduction

Off-street parking for residential uses must be on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [2] (§17-10-0601-B). Parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 ft of the front property line, but is permitted in a required side setback when accessed by a permitted driveway from the front [2] (§17-10-0601-A).

The property has an existing 1-car garage. **No transit-related parking reduction applies** — TOD parking relief under §17-10-0102-B requires the parcel to be in a transit-served location, and this parcel is not TOD-eligible.

Specific minimum parking counts by use/unit type are in §17-10-0200 — that section was not retrieved; verify the exact requirement for your proposed use with DPD.

---

### 6. Coach House / ADU

**Not permitted.** A coach house (accessory dwelling unit in a detached accessory building) may only be established on an RS-zoned lot that is within a designated ADU-Allowed RS Area [3] (§17-7-0570); [4] (§17-9-0201-F.1). This parcel **is not** in such an area. No conversion unit or coach house may be permitted here under current zoning.

**Verify:** §17-7-0574 lists all designated ADU-Allowed RS Areas — confirm the parcel's absence there with the Dept. of Housing (ADU pre-certification program).

---

### Confidence & Limitations

- **High confidence:** Zoning district (authoritative parcel match), FAR, max height, min lot area, ADU status, flood zone, overlays — all from official city GIS and the Municipal Code (current through Council Journal of March 18, 2026; a later amendment could affect these standards).
- **Could not confirm:** Front, rear, and side setback dimensions (§17-2-0400 not retrieved); precise parking minimums by use (§17-10-0200 not retrieved); assessed value (no assessment history on record).
- **Assessment data:** No assessment history was returned for this parcel from Cook County; the estimated annual property tax is **~$7,247** (2024 rates, primarily to Chicago Board of Education ~$3,976, City of Chicago ~$1,768, and Cook County ~$428). The property carries Homeowner and Senior Citizen exemptions reducing the EAV by $18,000 combined.
